GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifetd back 8l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 4l off clear rails run, running on half off 100m, took over 50m drew clear late # saved ground/ran on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly landed box seat 2-3l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on one pace # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, made contact and lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled last 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted outwards, and shortly after was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased to last 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well with little luck in straight # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: to be ridden conservatively; settled at rear of field. Shortly after the start was bumped by a runner which shifted in. For a short distance approaching the 200m was held up for clear running behind another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, held together turn, joined Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m, kept on one pace, tired late # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. Rdr reported it was not her intention to lead the race, but with the slow tempo in the early stages, was able to obtain the lead without being pressured. She added her mnt travelled comfortably in the lead through the middle stages, but when placed under pressure near the 400m failed to quicken and weakened over the final 100m, and in her opinion, it would appreciate racing on a track with more give.  A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to have blood in the offside nostril. Tnr was advised of the provisions of AR79(8). Gallop satisfactorily.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 4th 4 Lengths Four Wide x 800m asked to go at the 400 couldn't quicken and # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Resumes having run fifth and third in Gosford trials. Showed nice talent during debut campaign. Big watch.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another runner. Near the 250m was shifted to the outside of a runner to maintain clear running.
